descriptor: Burnt Out Games is an independent game studio. Speed shooter, to narrative adventure, to online experiences.
heroSub: We make games that are fun to make, so you'll have fun playing.
aboutShort: We started Burnt Out Games as game design students, working together on project after project because it was the best part of the week. Since then we've put two games on Steam, with EXO (our highly anticipated third) on the way.
aboutLong:
We started Burnt Out Games as game design students, working together on project after project because it was the best part of the week. Since then we've put two games on Steam, with EXO (our highly anticipated third) on the way.

We play, we study, we make. We seek to push boundaries in gaming, always asking questions of what a game can be. Burning down those walls is the entire reason we're here.

Disclaimer: We are not burnt out. We're burning bright.
communityBlurb: Updates, playtests, and bogging it up. Bring your fire, we'll bring ours.
gamesIntro: Speed shooter, to narrative adventure, to online experiences. We'll never confine to a genre, always chasing our next big idea for something fun to make (and funner to play).
devlogIntro: The stuff we're excited about that won't fit in a Discord message or an IG story. Systems we're proud of, things we worked out along the way, big project milestones.
contactBlurb: Send us a message! For any inquiries in feedback, press, publishing, and playtesting.
teamPhotoCaption: Ten of us, plus contributors on EXO.
